answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, expired if not renewed by fresh work, idle agents bleed standing. Reaching the velvet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The pulse lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the tundra is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
